q: Which snack has the most sugar per 100 g?
How many times more energy is in crisps than in a banana?
Recommend the best snack for a teenager before football. Justify with data.
Banana: some sugar for quick energy (12 g), almost no fat or salt, and low energy so it does not replace a meal.
A pack of crisps is 25 g. Calculate the salt in one pack and explain why comparing per 100 g is still useful.
1.3 × 25 / 100 = 0.33 g. Per 100 g lets you compare foods fairly even when pack sizes differ.
